name: Lyric Motion
author: Alfamin
description: Word-synced lyrics move letter by letter with the singer: each letter grows a touch as the highlight reaches it, long notes grow more and glow, and Persian, Arabic and Hebrew lyrics are laid out from the right. By Alfamin.

settings.label: Animation
settings.description: Smooth: each word is a step of its own and its last letters finish a moment into the next word. Crisp: every word finishes exactly on its note. Flowing: the motion passes along the line in one piece. Off: Noctis's own motion.

settings.label: Strength
settings.description: How much words grow, and how much long notes grow and glow.

settings.label: Letter by letter
settings.description: A word grows one letter at a time, with the highlight. Off: each word moves in one piece.

settings.label: Long note from (ms)
settings.description: A word sung at least this long counts as a long note: it grows more and glows. Lower means more words get it.

settings.label: Right-to-left lyrics
settings.description: Persian, Arabic, Hebrew and other right-to-left lyrics are found by themselves: their words run from the right, the lines sit against the right edge and each word fills in from the right.

settings.label: Also in the side panel and mini player
settings.description: Off: only the lyrics page moves. Right-to-left lyrics are laid out everywhere.
